## Library loading
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library("table1")
library(ggridges)
```

## Load data
```{r}
inner_df <- read_tsv(file = here("data/03_dat_aug_inner.tsv"))
left_df <- read_tsv(file = here("data/03_dat_aug_left.tsv"))
```

## Coverage
```{r}
# Simple description of the data found
left_df |>
  summarise(countries = n_distinct(country_code),
            first_year = min(year),
            last_year = max(year))

# Number of values per variable
left_df |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mortality_rate,
                        measles_coverage,
                        stunting_prevalence),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") |>
  drop_na(value) |>
  count(variable)
```

## Medians by region in latest decade
```{r}
#| message: false

# Info presented in a tidy table
left_df |>
  filter(between(year, 2020, 2024)) |>
  group_by(country_code, region) |>
  summarise(Mortality_rate = median(mortality_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
            Measles_coverage = median(measles_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
            Stunting_prevalence = median(stunting_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
            ungroup() |>
  mutate(who_region = factor(region)) |>
  table1(x = formula(~ Mortality_rate + Measles_coverage + Stunting_prevalence | who_region),
         data = _)
```

## Visualize data by decades
```{r}
# Prepare data for ridgeline plot
ridge_data <- left_df |>
  mutate(decade = floor(year / 10) * 10) |>
  filter(year == decade,
         decade >= 1960) |>
  drop_na(mortality_rate) |>
  mutate(decade = as_factor(decade))

# Ridgeline plot for under-5 mortality per region
ridge_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mortality_rate,
             y = fct_rev(decade),
             fill = decade)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 1.5,
                      alpha = 0.8,
                      quantile_lines = TRUE,
                      quantiles = 2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ region) +
  labs(title = "Under-5 mortality by decade and WHO region",
       x = "Under-5 mortality (per 1,000 live births, log scale)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_ridges() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9))

```
